text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: zenworks-prod (tenant: zenworks-3) - sustained 5xx spike and high tail latency from VPC dedicated pool dp-42. Trigger: error-rate > 5% for 5m, p95 latency > 1.2s for 3m. Impact: customer-facing API errors. Pager sent to on-call.

sara: I'm on it. grabbing logs and the pool dashboard now. @miguel you'll want to check autoscaler and node health, devon please look at model variants & recent rollout history.

miguel: seeing a flurry of 'ModelInvocationError: kv-cache mismatch' on pod gpud-7 in dp-42, CPU fine, GPU memory spiking then stabilizing. Autoscaler not scaling out; API shows a handful of connection resets to backend. linking graph: https://dash.redwood/teams/incidents/dp-42

devon: model metrics show increased token decode time for model: rw-psi-3.1. There's a canary that was promoted ~1h ago from rw-psi-3.0-safe -> rw-psi-3.1 (diff: attention kernel). Candidate hypothesis: 3.1 interacts poorly with current KV cache config under warm-start load; fallback variant rw-psi-3.0-safe has stable p95.

sara: customer is on Dedicated/VPC with tenant isolation. We need a low-risk mitigation: pin tenant to safe variant, route new requests to rw-psi-3.0-safe while probes run. Also prepare a canary rollback if pin fails. @anna pls pre-notify AM and slack the customer contact.

anna: pinged AM and sent 'we're investigating' note to zenworks SRE. They reported increased latency from their app ~15m ago. AM will be on the call if we ask.

kevin: what about cache invalidation? If kv-cache mismatch is present, we should avoid flushing globally. Suggest routing traffic to safe variant without touching shared caches. That keeps other tenants unaffected.

devon: agreed. plan: 1) create per-tenant routing override in routing-table for tenant zenworks-3 -> model rw-psi-3.0-safe (non-destructive) 2) enable short-lived canary on 5% of traffic to verify stable 10m 3) monitor p95/p99 and error-rate 4) if stable, flip 100% 5) schedule rollback window if not stable.

sara: do the routing override and canary first. Provide the exact commands.

devon: command to pin via internal control plane:

```
# pin tenant to safe variant (non-evicting)
redwoodctl routing set-override --tenant zenworks-3 --model rw-psi-3.0-safe --scope tenant --priority 100 --duration 2h

# create canary policy
redwoodctl routing create-canary --tenant zenworks-3 --model rw-psi-3.0-safe --traffic 5% --monitoring "error-rate,p95,p99" --window 10m
```

miguel: before you flip full, check dp-42 node gpud-7 logs for OOM or driver resets. If this is node-level, routing won't help. Also check NLB connections/timeouts.

sara: running those checks now. gpud-7 logs show repeated 'cuBLAS failure' around the same timeframe as the model rollout. gpu driver complaints + retry storms. Rolling pin probably will route away from that node, but we should cordon it.

kevin: I'll cordon gpud-7 and drain new allocations off it. Cordon command:

```
kubectl cordon gpud-7 --cluster dp-42
kubectl drain gpud-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

sara: cordon started. node drain in progress. If we drain, autoscaler may spin up replacement capacity; watch for scheduling delays.

deploy-bot: routing override created by devon at 1768123602. Canary policy started for tenant zenworks-3 -> rw-psi-3.0-safe at 5% traffic.

devon: canary is live. starting targeted health checks: run 50 sanity prompts via internal harness.

dry-run:
```
POST /v1/generate
{"model":"rw-psi-3.0-safe","input":"sanity: summarize the following..."}
```

sara: initial canary results (3m): error-rate 0.4%, p95 310ms, p99 680ms. Good sign. Meanwhile dp-42 replacements are scheduling; gpud-7 still not fully drained (some pods stuck in Terminating). Logs show a failing CUDA pattern for older driver (nvidia 525). Should file infra follow-up.

miguel: I've opened infra ticket INFRA-3287 for driver mismatch in dp-42; CC'ing infra on thread. For immediate impact, routing override + canary looks to be taking effect.

anna: zenworks AM confirmed they see errors dropping in their app, but asked for ETA to fully recover.

sara: ETA: 10-15m to promote canary -> 100% if metrics remain stable. I'll own the timeline and customer comms. @ryan please pick up post-incident remediation for model rollout gating (we need stronger pre-promotion checks).

ryan: got it. will scope a postmortem item: enforce KV-cache smoke tests and driver compatibility check in rollout pipeline.

kevin: can we avoid immediate full pin and instead extend 5% to 20% to shorten time? risk tradeoff?

devon: we can step to 20% now. I'll update canary policy.

devon: updated canary to 20% at 1768123750. monitoring continues.

sara: metrics at 20% after 4m: error-rate 0.3%, p95 320ms. safe. proceeding to promote to 100% route.

devon: promoting to 100% now via redwoodctl routing promote-override --tenant zenworks-3 --override-id OR-1768123602 --target 100%

deploy-bot: override OR-1768123602 promoted to 100% at 1768123808. Model traffic switched to rw-psi-3.0-safe for tenant zenworks-3.

sara: zenworks AM reports their customer traffic healthy. marking impact reduced. Next steps: keep override for 2h (devon set 2h), don't evict pod-level caches, infra to replace failed node gpud-7 and validate driver, follow-up with deployment rollback of rw-psi-3.1 until we scope fix.

miguel: confirming autoscaler added 2 nodes and drained gpud-7 eventually. dp-42 health now shows 0 pod evictions in last 5m.

anna: I've sent the customer a recovery note and told them we'll follow up with root cause and remediation plan. They asked for timeline on full rollback of 3.1 - we'll update after analysis.

sara: thanks all. I'll close the pager once we hit 30m of stable metrics and hand over to ryans's remediation track. If anything shifts, re-open pager.

ryan: taking post-incident tasks. creating P0->P1 backlog: - rollout pipeline KV smoke tests - driver compatibility gate - per-model pre-promotion perf tests. Will assign owners.

sara: closing note: what went well: quick tenant-level routing override, canary policy worked, cordon prevented further noisy retries. Actions: infra driver fix, rollout gating, improve visibility on per-tenant kv-cache mismatches.

sara: closing pager. :white_check_mark: (added :thumbsup: react)

incident-bot: Pager resolved for zenworks-prod at 1768123899 (duration ~7m).
